new_proved_split_nodes.statement: For a finite nested chain D_0 superset ... superset D_H, every contact between the accumulated prefix int(D_0) minus D_j and the next or any future shell lies on the current separator partial D_j. Gluing the prefix to the next shell along the actual active part of partial D_j reconstructs the next prefix exactly.

After any finite regular protected collar, obstacle, ideal-wall, and electrode inventory has been frozen, removing that inventory does not create prefix-to-next-shell contacts away from the current separator. The remaining active separator arcs glue exactly and every forbidden boundary remains a typed side port or wall.

For nested closed Jordan pieces, the set of levels on which one open boundary atom persists is an integer interval. A physical contact atom never leaves and later reactivates; nonconsecutive shell contacts are consecutive persistence intervals viewed in shell-only coordinates.

For the binary direct-decoration package, a finite root boundary atomization E and partial atom maps tau_a give the exact root-shared mask recursion R_{j+1}=tau_a(R_j intersect A_a). The structural contact history has at most 2^|E| states, independent of address depth but not uniformly over all decoration blocks.

At each prefix-to-cell junction every structural open atom is exactly one of genuine glue, zero-energy transport, root-side-only cell port, or double inactive. A finite protected overlay refines these classes without adding another structural approach type.

The exact closed Dirichlet response of an accumulated physical prefix is updated by gluing only genuine separator traces, transporting persistent traces, coupling root-side cell ports, retaining live protected ports, and minimizing internal traces. The output is the actual-domain Dirichlet form of the next prefix, so no abstract closed-form pushforward theorem is used.

Current contact mask, external labels, current separator trace coordinate, and the exact Dirichlet response form are a future-sufficient state for every finite continuation by the binary root-cell catalog.

Every future direct-decoration cell interacts with the accumulated past only through the current separator, with at most |E| structural contact atoms. An old unseeded port absent from the separator is geometrically unreachable by all future cells. The finite proof-use overlay remains horizon-dependent.

Using the actual conformal maps h_w:D_w to P at every stage, the finite-horizon physical response is generated by a fixed root-cell catalog and finite contact masks. No word-dependent global welding map is omitted. Norm compactness of the orbit is not asserted.

Every zero-cell-energy contact atom either exits the finite contact graph within the number of structural atoms or enters a recurrent strongly connected component that must be retained as an exact neutral presentation mode.

For one fixed block, fixed finite feature space, and fixed word length, every accumulated physical-energy Gramian controls squared distance from its exact neutral kernel by a positive block-dependent constant. No universal constant or dimension is claimed.
